item.text: [{"task_id":"ea9794b1","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    size = int(round(params['canvas'][0]))","    background = int(round(params['canvas'][1]))","    if size <= 0 or size > min(grid.shape) or not np.any(grid == background):","        return grid.copy()","    out = np.full((size, size), background)","    for layer in params['layers']:","        color = int(round(layer[0]))","        row = int(round(layer[1]))","        col = int(round(layer[2]))","        if row < 0 or col < 0 or row + size > grid.shape[0] or col + size > grid.shape[1]:","            return grid.copy()","        patch = grid[row:row + size, col:col + size]","        out = np.where(patch == color, patch, out)","    return out"],"shapes":{"canvas":[2],"layers":[4,3]},"params":{"canvas":[5,0],"layers":[[4,0,0],[8,5,5],[9,5,0],[3,0,5]]},"rationale":"Overlay the four aligned 5×5 quadrants, with color priority 3 over 9 over 8 over 4; uncovered cells remain 0. This reproduces all six demonstrations."}]
